subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: Should Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan UUID-style keys be supported for the general `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201` route, redirected to `volcengine-plan`, or treated as an unsupported-key diagnostic?
rationale: The source shows OpenClaw's current split and shallow setup validation, but only maintainers with vendor context or live credentials can choose the intended contract without breaking existing Volcengine users.

options.title: Verify and fix provider route
options.body: Use a live Lite/Coding Plan key to decide whether the affected general model should be hidden, remapped, or documented as unsupported for Lite keys.

options.title: Add diagnostic only
options.body: Keep both catalogs unchanged and add provider-owned setup/runtime guidance when a Lite key is rejected on the general endpoint.

options.title: Close as external key issue
options.body: Close only if live proof or official docs confirm UUID Lite keys are not supported by any advertised OpenClaw Volcengine route.

recommendation.title: Verify and fix provider route
recommendation.body: Use a live Lite/Coding Plan key to decide whether the affected general model should be hidden, remapped, or documented as unsupported for Lite keys.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant Volcengine plugin boundary and provider-auth alias history mostly routes through steipete's recent commits.
